text:
Sam: Imagine you could work in any fictional office/universe for a week. Where are you going and why? no wrong answers :smile:
Ivy: The Dunder Mifflin Scranton branch. Chaos, coffee, and memos. plus Michael Scott energy :coffee:
Omar: Paper sales meet dark comedy. I second this for meme potential
Bea: The Bridge from Star Trek. Quiet warp drives and a snack replicator. also low email volume? :rocket:
Sam: love the practicality of a replicator. instant lunch wins
Ivy: Also, I feel like HR would be... very interesting there :thinking_face:
Omar: My pick: The Weasley Ministry of Magic office (Harry Potter). Cobwebs, enchanted paperwork, and a nice drawer that sorts your forms for you
Bea: Enchanted paperwork = never missing an expense report. sign me up
DeployBot: Reminder: fictional office day is not a real paid time off policy. :robot_face:
Sam: lol noted. last vote: Dunder Mifflin, Starship Bridge, Ministry of Magic. react with :one:, :two:, or :three:
Ivy: :one:
Bea: :two:
Omar: :three:
Sam: Tally: one=1, two=1, three=1  tie. tiebreaker  what's one quirky perk you're most excited about in your pick?
Ivy: Office parties that include actual cake and terrible themed games (Dunder Mifflin)
Bea: Quiet console time and 'views of the stars' (Bridge)
Omar: A cauldron that brews tea on demand and occasionally sneezes confetti (Ministry)
Sam: This thread is peak morale. thanks team. unofficial takeaway: if we ever do a themed slack meetup, expect cake, telescopes, and confetti tea :tada:
